clauses.title: CL-D100 records that external review is best effort
clauses.section: ## CL-D100 — External review is best effort
requires: tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents#226
is reported as observed and is never waited for and never a failure
A requirement only a human or GitHub settles never holds `MERGE_READY` back and is named in `operator_actions`
Waiting for a provider again, treating a provider's state as a failure, or holding `MERGE_READY` back for a requirement named above requires a new owner decision.
A branch protection the workflow cannot read is settled by GitHub's own `mergeable_state`
every ruleset and protection setting the workflow reads but does not evaluate

clauses.title: Review-only states the best-effort rule
requires: External review is best effort (CL-D100): answer each external finding present; never wait for one still to come.
CodeRabbit's state, and its own check run or status that no protection requires, is only reported.
a ruleset or protection setting read but not evaluated
never holds `MERGE_READY` back; name it in `operator_actions`

clauses.title: Exact autofix states the best-effort rule
requires: failed checks or `CHANGES_REQUESTED` is `BLOCKED`.
A policy the workflow does not evaluate (ruleset, protection setting, approval, `blocked` state) is named in `operator_actions`
a provider's state or own unrequired check, even `unknown`, is reported; neither waits or fails (CL-D100)
A protection that cannot be read is settled by `mergeable_state`.
final policy failed is `BLOCKED`

clauses.title: Readiness separates what waits from what a human confirms and what was observed
requires: return { failed, pending, unresolved, confirm, observed };
if (state === 'blocked') confirm.push(
c.app?.slug === REVIEW_APP && !required(c.name, c.app.id)
context === 'CodeRabbit' && st.creator?.login === 'coderabbitai[bot]' && !required(context)
external review is not waited for

clauses.title: MERGE_READY names what a human confirms
requires: `before merging, a human confirms: ${r.confirm.join('; ')}`

clauses.section: ## CL-D18 — External observation is reported, not enforced
requires: CL-D100 later made external review best effort: the quiet period and the window are gone

clauses.title: CL-D93 names the later rule
clauses.section: ## CL-D93 — A packaged driver sequences the review; the parent only makes the calls it prints
requires: CL-D100 later made external review best effort: the driver waits for no provider, quiet period, or observation window

clauses.title: The best-effort outcomes are pinned
requires: Issue #196 a missing required approval does not hold MERGE_READY back, and the operator\'s actions name it
Issue #196 a recent external event does not hold MERGE_READY back, and the publication reports it as observed
Issue #196 an external review provider\'s state and its own check run are observed, never waited for
Issue #196 a protection the driver cannot read is settled by mergeability: clean names nothing, blocked is named
